title: Ruthenium-catalyzed dimerization of vanillin for the formation of a biobased epoxy thermoset resin
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,2366-2376
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00165J, Paper

Flavia Ferrara, Iuliana Ribca, Namratha Prabhu, Josselin Mante, Maureen Gumbo, Andreas Ekebergh, Mats Johansson, Nina Kann
An epoxy divanillin ester was prepared using ruthenium catalysis and incorporated into a thermoset, providing an alternative to bisphenol A.
